instruction: Fix `binary_search` in `seqops/search.py` so it finds the last element of a sorted list and the only element of a single-element list. It currently exits its loop one iteration too early, so searching for the last element (or the sole element of a one-element list) returns -1 instead of the correct index.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/search.py b/seqops/search.py
--- a/seqops/search.py
+++ b/seqops/search.py
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
     occurs multiple times, the index of any occurrence is returned.
     """
     lo, hi = 0, len(items) - 1
-    while lo < hi:
+    while lo <= hi:
         mid = (lo + hi) // 2
         if items[mid] == target:
             return mid
